measurements.unit_of_analysis: A reported measurement or a separately identified evaluation observation.
measurements.numeric_values: Only explicitly normalized observations have result_value, baseline_value, and unit. Null does not mean zero.
measurements.missing_information: Unknown design, sample, and uncertainty remain null. A record-level reported measure is not a new evaluation.
measurements.review: review_state is inherited from the underlying measure. extraction_basis identifies a new source review when one occurred.
measurements.qualifications: field_qualifications retains each evaluation field's availability, review state, and public qualified answer. An unresolved answer is not promoted to a confirmed value.
